pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any firework rocket. Its full design is retained. Creative defaults use a white small-ball firework.

Starts waiting; select Watch. It monitors same-owner workers in range. After the chosen continuous blocked delay, it launches a harmless signal, repeating every ten seconds while the worker stays blocked.

The delay is 1–60 minutes, default five. Manual pauses and completed work do not count. Right-click launches a manual signal; applying a rocket replaces the saved design. Healing, dyes, washing, and tuners take priority.
